narrative: Proposes that consciousness is not generated by physical complexity but is a primitive dimension orthogonal to spacetime — the way mass or charge are primitive — implying the universe has always had an interior. The chapter situates this against the hard problem of consciousness, rejects eliminativist and functionalist dodges, and draws on Whitehead's prehension and Teilhard's Within as precursors to the dimensional framing.
